entities.summary: Sirodjidin Aslov (b. 1964-02-17, Temurmalik District) was a explorer or navigator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Temurmalik District and Tajikistan. Known in the fields of tajikistan, political leaders, asia.
